list.name: agent
list.label: Agent

query.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(a.name, CASE WHEN e.agent_id = e.user_id || '-agent' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ud.name,''), NULLIF(ud.email,''), e.user_id) || ' (personal)' END, e.agent_id) AS "__text", e.agent_id AS "__value"
FROM llm_usage_events e
LEFT JOIN user_directory ud ON ud.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND ud.subject = e.user_id
LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id::text = e.agent_id
WHERE e.agent_id <> ''
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Spend today

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_micros), 0) / 1000000.0 AS spend
FROM llm_usage_events
WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now())
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${source:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${grp:sqlstring}) OR user_groups && ARRAY[${grp:sqlstring}]::text[])

panels.description: Month-to-date spend divided by elapsed days, projected over the full calendar month. Ignores the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM llm_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${source:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${grp:sqlstring}) OR user_groups && ARRAY[${grp:sqlstring}]::text[])

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_micros), 0) / 1000000.0 / GREATEST(COUNT(*), 1)
       AS avg_cost
FROM llm_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${source:sqlstring}) OR source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${grp:sqlstring}) OR user_groups && ARRAY[${grp:sqlstring}]::text[])

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(e.ts, $__interval),
       CASE '$groupby'
         WHEN 'user_id'  THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ud.name,''), NULLIF(ud.email,''), e.user_id)
         WHEN 'agent_id' THEN COALESCE(a.name, CASE WHEN e.agent_id = e.user_id || '-agent' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ud.name,''), NULLIF(ud.email,''), e.user_id) || ' (personal)' END, e.agent_id)
         ELSE e.${groupby:raw}
       END AS metric,
       SUM(e.cost_micros) / 1000000.0 AS spend
FROM llm_usage_events e
LEFT JOIN user_directory ud ON ud.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND ud.subject = e.user_id
LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id::text = e.agent_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR e.tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR e.provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR e.model IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR e.agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR e.user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${source:sqlstring}) OR e.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${grp:sqlstring}) OR e.user_groups && ARRAY[${grp:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval),
       SUM(tokens_in) AS "input",
       SUM(tokens_out) AS "output",
       SUM(cache_read) AS "cache read"
FROM llm_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))

  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${grp:sqlstring}) OR user_groups && ARRAY[${grp:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 20 sessions by spend

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.session_id,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(ud.name,''), NULLIF(ud.email,''), e.user_id) AS "user",
       COALESCE(a.name, CASE WHEN e.agent_id = e.user_id || '-agent' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ud.name,''), NULLIF(ud.email,''), e.user_id) || ' (personal)' END, e.agent_id) AS "agent",
       COUNT(*) AS calls,
       SUM(e.tokens_in + e.tokens_out) AS tokens,
       SUM(e.cost_micros) / 1000000.0 AS cost
FROM llm_usage_events e
LEFT JOIN user_directory ud ON ud.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND ud.subject = e.user_id
LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id::text = e.agent_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.session_id <> ''
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR e.tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR e.provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR e.model IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR e.agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR e.user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${source:sqlstring}) OR e.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${grp:sqlstring}) OR e.user_groups && ARRAY[${grp:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20

  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))

  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${grp:sqlstring}) OR user_groups && ARRAY[${grp:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT e.ts,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(ud.name,''), NULLIF(ud.email,''), e.user_id) AS "user",
       COALESCE(a.name, CASE WHEN e.agent_id = e.user_id || '-agent' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(ud.name,''), NULLIF(ud.email,''), e.user_id) || ' (personal)' END, e.agent_id) AS "agent",
       e.model,
       e.source,
       e.tokens_in,
       e.tokens_out,
       e.cost_micros / 1000000.0 AS cost
FROM llm_usage_events e
LEFT JOIN user_directory ud ON ud.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND ud.subject = e.user_id
LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id::text = e.agent_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR e.tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR e.provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR e.model IN (${model:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR e.agent_id IN (${agent:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR e.user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${source:sqlstring}) OR e.source IN (${source:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${grp:sqlstring}) OR e.user_groups && ARRAY[${grp:sqlstring}]::text[])
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Governance (monthly caps — llm_spend_counters is the authoritative meter)
Cap utilization per user (this month)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ud.name,''), NULLIF(ud.email,''), c.user_id) AS "user",
       SUM(c.cost_micros)::float
         / NULLIF(MAX(cap.cap_micros), 0) AS utilization
FROM llm_spend_counters c
JOIN spend_caps cap
  ON cap.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
 AND cap.scope = 'user'
 AND cap.subject_id = c.user_id
LEFT JOIN user_directory ud
  ON ud.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND ud.subject = c.user_id
WHERE c.period_start = date_trunc('month', now())::date
  AND c.user_id <> ''
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${tenant:sqlstring}) OR c.tenant_id::text IN (${tenant:sqlstring}))
  AND ('__ALL__' IN (${usr:sqlstring}) OR c.user_id IN (${usr:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY utilization DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20
